_meta.limitation: This catalog lists every compiled event (path, GUID, exposed local parameters) and, where known, which TACZ gun id / weapon category consumes it and for what action (shoot/reload/draw/holster/suppressed). It does NOT include per-event randomized-playback internals (which of the bank's ~4164 raw audio samples a multi/random instrument picks, or their probability weights). FMOD Studio's public runtime API (Studio::EventDescription / Studio::EventInstance, the only API this JNI wrapper exposes) does not expose the compiled instrument/playlist tree at all -- that data lives only in the bank's internal EVNT chunk and is normally inspected via the FMOD Studio editor GUI, which needs the original .fspro project (not present in this repo; only the compiled .bank files are checked in). Getting sample-level randomization weights would require either the original FMOD Studio project or reverse-engineering the EVNT binary chunk format, neither of which this catalog attempts.
